model: buhl-locust-2006 marching locusts (Czirok 1D SPP; genuine-agent, 1D ring, disclosed)

config.knob: ONLY the ring length (= density = N/Lr) is dialled; all rules fixed

verdicts.label: P1
verdicts.gate: P1 density crossover: mean |<v>| < 0.3 at lowest density AND > 0.7 at highest density

verdicts.label: P2
verdicts.gate: P2 intermittent switching: near-critical density reverses (rate>0, >=1 seed) while the high-density median run never reverses (rate~=0)

verdicts.label: P3
verdicts.gate: P3 monotone ordering: mean |<v>| non-decreasing in density (tol 0.05)
